★Request
In the second half, Kiseki is struck by a bolt of inspiration.

★Request
Takes out tablet (prop1157_00) and stylus pen (prop1758_00)

Huh? ...Oh, right! This strategy
is totally useless if I can't grab a spot right on the rail. Scrapped!

I tell her to hold on before making such a hasty conclusion. Perhaps because
she comes up with ideas one after another, she has no hesitation in discarding them.
Just how much are you expecting from me?! Honestly, what kind of person are you?!

Kiseki swore she would create an exciting race next time and claim victory!
And then, lo and behold?! Three entire trainers stepped forward to offer their help!

A notification pops up on my phone.
It seems to be a message from Kiseki.

Could I prove to an Umamusume as captivating as Kiseki that
I'm the trainer who can guide her to her dreams, and earn her contract?

Heheh, I think I've got plenty of confidence in that department——..................
..................————————Whaaat?!

I saw it in a car racing manga! In a race, cornering speed
is just as important as top speed on the straightaways! So——
"Ah! Understood!"

Previously! After suffering defeat against formidable rivals,
Kiseki made a promise for a rematch, determined to challenge them once more in a mock race.

She comes sprinting through the driving rain, paying no heed to the downpour.
On top of that, she mentioned the trainer's office just a moment ago. That means——

First, take a look! Could you give me your opinion?!
An idea struck me this morning! Geez, I just couldn't wait!!

A few days have passed since I resolved to give her my all. Honestly, my current standing with her...
...would make it no surprise if she kicked me to the curb at any second.

(Come to think of it, cornering isn't a technique meant only for chasers!
If that's where I felt a chance of victory... then that means...!)

To make matters worse, the downpour is only getting heavier. My hope that it would let up if I waited was dashed...
and the train schedules seem completely derailed, too.

Yet she didn't do that. She must have had an underlying intention.
If she isn't consciously aware of it... I'll help put it into words and give shape to her subconscious.

While Kiseki is thrilled about the situation,
I, as a trainer, can't help feeling a bit conflicted.
...? Trainer?

Huh... expand it into something else...?
Hmm... uhhh～～...?!

Using the inner rail directly might be difficult from a safety and rules standpoint.
However, focusing on cornering speed is an intriguing angle. If so...——

I-I just had an unbelievable revelation!
——Anyway, please hear me out!!

...? You seem somewhat hesitant today, Trainer.
You've had your arms crossed this entire time, too...

Something has been nagging at me. If she were aiming to win with a late burst like last time,
she would normally focus on top straightaway speed, not cornering.

(...The other trainers give specific instructions.
So much so that I don't even have to make decisions myself. ...Yet this person...)

(Even though there are trainers who give me total freedom without interfering!
And you used to be just an audience member...! So why am I——)
"I know you can arrive at an even more fascinating idea."

I want an Umamusume to run as she pleases during a race.
That's why I won't tell you how or why. The thinking is up to you, Kiseki.
"I know you can arrive at an even more fascinating idea."

I set down my umbrella and documents to take the tablet from her.
I was in shock. To think she'd actually run all the way here... She truly is——
Ah——yes! My apologies!

That night, Kiseki sent me a massive 48-page manga storyboard.
It seems she had been fleshing out her race strategy through manga.

"Where are you right now?
The lights in the trainer's office were on, though."

Now, run freely! I will protect your drive and your creativity!
After all, that independence is your greatest weapon!

*pant*, *pant*... Trainer, doesn't this feel like a training arc episode?!
I feel like my running power has gone up by at least 50,000!

Focus more, Kiseki!
Neglect the basics, and your late burst won't amount to anything!

Your drive for self-improvement is truly magnificent, Kiseki. However, both your form
and acceleration lack fundamentals. Let's fix that! You have tremendous room to grow!

(——Why was I focusing on the curves in the first place, anyway?
Cornering is important for accelerating into the final straight, sure, but...)

"...Why did you come up with that idea, Kiseki?"
"Try expanding on that concept into another approach."

Ta-da! My next new special move! Its name is 'Centrifugal Force Evade'!!
The moment I hit the turn, I grab onto the inner rail and swing roooound with it!
There you aaaaare, Traiiiiineeeeer!!

Kiseki has the heart of a true artist. She naturally wants to immerse herself comfortably in her creations.
A situation where she's forced to stall like this can't be pleasant for her.
Yet having fallen in love with her running, I refuse to back down either.

——Ah, Trainer! I'm sorry after all!
Um, let's forget about that idea on the tablet, too!

Over the weekend, I headed out to buy new reference materials for Kiseki,
only to find myself stranded by a sudden torrential downpour.

...I want her to engage wholeheartedly with her creative vision.
I'm willing to do whatever it takes to support that. Even if it makes her resent me——

"...Why did you come up with that idea, Kiseki?"
"Try expanding on that concept into another approach."

After being stranded for several dozen minutes... I suddenly hear footsteps sprinting furiously in the distance.
Who could possibly be brave enough to run in this weather——...
(*pitter, patter patter... whoooosh!*)

*pant*... *pant*... *phew*——...
............Here, take a look!!
